notes: A finish_reason outside OpenAI's five values raises a pydantic ValidationError (ChatCompletion.model_validate), so the response is lost. Also reproduced on 1.33.3. The same error reaches provider='openai' pointed at Ollama's OpenAI-compatible endpoint (ollama-openai).

Existing upstream issue, not opened by wiretruth. Ollama sends an id on each tool call, but the ollama Python client (0.6.3, latest) has no field for it, so any-llm's native provider generates UUIDs instead (providers/ollama/utils.py).

any-llm documents the fallback: a done_reason outside stop, length, tool_calls, content_filter and function_call is reported as stop (https://github.com/mozilla-ai/any-llm/blob/18ed82b8ae89db560bf0b1ec8bccb752fc0e2b5d/src/any_llm/providers/ollama/utils.py#L33-L46). The caller cannot tell an unfamiliar reason from a normal stop.

Existing upstream issue, not opened by wiretruth. Ollama's OpenAI-compatible endpoint ignores max_completion_tokens (v0.40.3), and any-llm's openai provider sends only that name (providers/openai/base.py), so the limit never applies. The root cause is in Ollama; the PR listed adds the field.
